title: Quanta
description: A playful, modern identity concept for an edtech brand focused on making complex subjects easier and more engaging to learn.
introduction: Quanta was a fictional edtech branding brief built around the ideas of learning, technology and curiosity. The direction called for something playful and modern while maintaining a high-tech feel.
wid: The name Quanta immediately connected to the concept of quantum mechanics. I explored the idea of an atom and translated its orbital structure into a simplified geometric symbol. The central form was then developed to subtly reference an education cap, combining science, technology and learning into one mark.
review: The concept development is what makes this identity stand out. The connection from quantum to atom and finally to education gives the mark a clear visual story.

title: Web3 Beast
description: A bold X banner and profile identity designed to create a strong first impression for a Web3-focused personal brand.
introduction: The goal was to create a visual identity for Web3 Beast that immediately communicated confidence, energy and its position within the Web3 space.
wid: The client provided initial concepts and references for the direction. I translated those ideas into a cleaner composition with stronger hierarchy, visual balance and a more distinctive Web3 aesthetic.
review: Kaiii, this is MAADDDDD. You're this good and you don't have clients. I'm definitely referring you to my guys.

title: Unity Bar and Restaurant
description: A distinctive visual identity concept for a bar and restaurant, built around the idea of unity and hospitality.
introduction: The project started with a simple request to create a logo. The goal was to develop a memorable symbol that could work across the restaurant's physical and digital touchpoints.
wid: I explored the idea of a bar stool as the foundation for the symbol. After several sketches, I refined the strongest concept into an abstract mark that communicates both the physical environment of a bar and the idea of people coming together.
review: This is Good Elisha, Keep Learning.

title: Wilio
description: A personal redesign study exploring how a cleaner layout and stronger visual hierarchy can improve a digital advertising creative.
introduction: This was a personal design study and is not affiliated with Wilio. I used an existing creative as a starting point to explore how I could improve its visual communication.
wid: The redesign focused primarily on layout, spacing, hierarchy and modern visual aesthetics. The goal was not to completely reinvent the concept, but to demonstrate how stronger design decisions can make an advertisement feel more polished and intentional.

title: Klever Wallet
description: A motion study exploring how a static brand mark can be transformed into a simple, memorable logo animation.
introduction: This was a personal motion design study based on the Klever Wallet logo. The project was created as an exploration of logo animation and is not affiliated with Klever Wallet.
wid: I started by studying the geometry of the logo and imagining how its grid structure could translate into motion. The animation develops from a flat geometric form into the finished logo, using a folding-paper-inspired movement.

title: Personal
description: A collection of motion graphics and animation experiments created for my personal brands, exploring different approaches to movement, storytelling and visual identity.
introduction: These pieces were created as part of my personal exploration of motion design for Uthux and my personal brand, Elisha Obadahun.
wid: I experimented with different workflows and tools, including FlipaClip on mobile and Adobe After Effects on PC. The projects allowed me to explore animation, timing, transitions and visual storytelling while developing my motion design skills.
review: Personal work. Created as part of my ongoing exploration of motion design.

title: House of Life Church
description: A collection of social media graphics created for House of Life Church across regular services, special programs and church events.
introduction: The project involves creating consistent and engaging promotional graphics for House of Life Church across its weekly services and special programs.
wid: I developed graphics for Sunday, Tuesday and Friday services alongside special events and programs. The work required maintaining consistency while giving each service and announcement its own visual identity.
btstext: A growing collection of church communications

title: CKCC
description: A collection of promotional and social media graphics created for CKCC, covering church events, celebrations and digital content.
introduction: The project focused on creating clear and visually engaging graphics that could communicate church events and announcements effectively across digital platforms.
wid: I focused on creating strong visual hierarchy, readable typography and compositions that communicate the key information quickly while maintaining a consistent visual quality.

title: Eddy
description: A collection of promotional graphics created for Eddy, covering courses, food services, events and other business communications.
introduction: This collection demonstrates how I adapt visual design to different offers and communication needs while keeping each creative clear and commercially focused.
wid: The work covered different types of promotional material, from training and educational offers to food-related promotions. I focused on making the information easy to understand while maintaining a strong visual presentation.
review: Client work created for Eddy Fries.

title: Proj. 65
description: A cultural streetwear branding concept exploring Nigerian identity through typography, apparel and multilingual visual elements.
introduction: Proj. 65 was developed as a branding exploration focused on Nigerian cultural identity and contemporary streetwear. The project explores how language, symbols and apparel can work together to create a recognizable brand.
wid: I explored the identity through a combination of typography, graphic elements and apparel applications. Hausa, Igbo and Yoruba versions were incorporated to emphasize the project's connection to Nigerian culture and its diverse audience.

title: ThesisFormat
description: An AI-powered SaaS project built to simplify academic document formatting and help students produce properly structured academic work.
introduction: ThesisFormat is a product development project focused on reducing the repetitive work involved in formatting academic documents. The concept combines software development with AI-assisted document processing.
wid: The project involved thinking through the user workflow, document formatting requirements and the technical implementation needed to turn an academic formatting process into a web-based product.

title: Okojere
description: A poster design project focused on creating a visually strong composition for an induction-related event.
introduction: The project involved developing an event poster that communicates the essential information while maintaining a strong visual presence.
wid: I focused on hierarchy, typography, spacing and composition to make the important information immediately accessible while keeping the overall design visually engaging.

title: Titan
description: A bold identity exploration built around strength, structure and a distinctive visual character.
introduction: Titan was a branding exploration focused on developing a strong and memorable identity. The project allowed me to experiment with form, typography and visual direction.
wid: The identity was developed by exploring different forms and compositions before refining the strongest direction into a cohesive visual system. The goal was to create something that felt strong without becoming visually excessive.
